stories.title: Warriors changes coming after second straight blowout loss without Steph Curry
stories.excerpt: NEW ORLEANS — When you lose in blowout fashion to a red-hot team that was in the NBA Finals five months ago, that’s one thing. When it’s followed by an almost-as-disastrous defeat to a bottom-of-the-barrel squad that had dropped its past six games, something’s got to give. “Especially in the fashion that we’ve lost,” guard De’Anthony Melton said, “expect things to change. As they should, given the last two losses, how we lost.” Golden State Warriors head coach Steve Kerr looks on during an NBA basketball game against the New Orleans Pelicans in New Orleans, Monday, Nov. 16, 2026. stories.title: Rough Hawks injury news: CJ McCollum out 4 weeks (calf strain), Asa Newell likely out for season (toe)
stories.excerpt: This is rough injury news for Atlanta, which at 8-6 sits tied for the 4/5 seeds in the East: • Guard CJ McCollum suffered a strained left calf and will be reevaluated in four weeks, the team announced. • Big man Asa Newell has surgery to repair a left great toe hyperextension, and while the Hawks' announcement says he will be re-evaluated in four months, that will be mid-March, weeks away from the end of the regular season (April 11).
